name: Foundr

sources.title: Homepage — 'curated directory of AI tools. Browse, search, and submit your own'
Submit route — auth-gated; sign in via Google or email magic link to 'manage your submitted tools'

requirements: AI tool — curated AI tools directory with categories, tags, leaderboard, and Collections (Latest/Featured/Coming Soon)
Account required before the submit form is shown: Google OAuth or email magic link
Dashboard exists to 'manage your submitted tools' — listings can be edited post-submission
preparation: Google account or email for magic-link sign-in
Product name, URL, description, logo, category/tags
workflow: Sign in via Google or email magic link
Complete the tool submission form in the dashboard
Listing appears in the directory and is eligible for the leaderboard/collections
watchFor: Not to be confused with foundr.com (entrepreneur media company) — this is a separate AI-tools directory
Pricing not visible before sign-in — paid 'Advertise' banner slots exist separately
Leaderboard and 'Coming Soon' collection suggest staged/scheduled listing states
Submit UI fully behind auth — agent must complete OAuth/magic-link interactively
countsAsLive: The tool has a public page on foundr.ai listed under its category/tags and Latest collection
unknowns: Whether organic submission is free or has a paid tier
What 'Coming Soon' gating means for new listings
